'''Darth Eldrid''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who was active during the time of the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="Ruins of Nul">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=flashpoint|Ruins of Nul}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Eldrid appears only in the playthrough of Imperial characters after completing the flashpoint "Ruins of Nul" in the ''Legacy of the Sith'' expansion and is the builder of the prison beneath [[Vaiken Spacedock]] that currently holds the rogue Sith [[Darth Malgus]].<ref name="Ruins of Nul">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=flashpoint|Ruins of Nul}}</ref>

[[Darth Krovos]] notes to Eldrid that the prison is holding up well and will share her recommendations with the [[Dark Council]]. Krovos also adds that Eldrid could prove to be a worthy contender for [[Darth Savik]]'s seat on the Dark Council.<ref name="Ruins of Nul">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=flashpoint|Ruins of Nul}}</ref>
